translation_snapshot.source: turn into a corrupted losgoroth (poison, disease, cut and confusion immune; converts half damage into life drain; does not require breath) for 10 turns

translation_snapshot.source: Magical wands are made by powerful Alchemists and Archmagi to store spells. Anybody can use them to release the spells.

translation_snapshot.source: cure up to %d diseases or poisons (based on Magic)
